text:
Marta: Quick sync  need final call on form validation patterns for Console: inline errors vs top summary, required markers for screen readers, and destructive confirm patterns. Short meeting.

James: Are we covering tiny delete modals and long create forms? UX differs.

Marta: Both. Goals: accessible, low-noise, fast for power users. Lean: inline errors next to fields + compact summary at top for long forms.

Sam: A11y checklist: move focus to first invalid field or the summary on submit; each error linked via aria-describedby; summary should be focusable and announced (role/alert or aria-live) but focus is most reliable.

Olivia: Required fields: visual asterisk + sr-only "required" in label, and aria-required on input when appropriate.

James: Validation timing: validate on submit by default; on-blur only for deterministic checks like email or repo slug.

Olivia: Destructive confirms: typed-confirm (enter resource name) for irreversible things (prod clusters, model snapshots); checkbox for mid-risk deletes. For typed-confirm disable keyboard shortcuts and require explicit click.

Marta: Decision: implement those patterns, add code examples in comps, and list which ops get typed-confirm vs checkbox in ticket.

aria-bot: Created UX ticket UX-2312 "Form validation patterns & destructive confirm policy" assigned to Marta, due in 3 days.
